name: mangiaplastica-cordova
description: Shell Cordova dell'app Mangiaplastica (UI in app-src/, build in www/)

scripts.android:prepare: npm run ui && cordova prepare android
scripts.android: npm run android:prepare && cordova run android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:prepare && cordova build android
scripts.android:release: npm run android:prepare && cordova build android --release -- --packageType=bundle
scripts.ios:prepare: npm run ui && cordova prepare ios
scripts.ios: npm run ios:prepare && cordova run ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:prepare && cordova build ios
scripts.ios:release: npm run ios:prepare && cordova build ios --release --device
